List approved drugs indicated for chronic kidney disease. Return ChEMBL ID, pref_name, canonical SMILES, EFO ID, indication label, and max_phase_for_ind. Filter by max_phase_for_ind = 4 and indication_label = 'chronic kidney disease'. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
